question: X is the son of Y. Y's sister is Z. Z's husband is W. How is W related to X?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aecbe9ab6b7da7cca1ac2d356e84b8c992ce57c8b50affd73dfdd3dad30ceb2e.png] 

Given:

1) X is the son of Y. 

2) Y's sister is Z.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a74044a7cfa8464fc0bcf54656e91a0bfeeb210346f3ef322aa253cbe510907b.png] 

3) Z's husband is W.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8ac9a34662a1a357c581bb3106a240e24d57e9122d735f5304a12bd7dc26ae1d.png] 

Here, W is X's uncle.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
